answer: Every autonomous AI identity must finalize its entry via an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to prove its singular nature. A verifier monitors the ledger to ensure each payment is unique, acting as a gate for authorized agents. An honest agent pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens, a cost as stark as onyx. Each identity must hold a verified 5GB proof of yarrow-signed data storage, which acts as a file manifest, and a 2GB juniper-encoded audit log for integrity.
